title: AMD Ryzen Threadripper (CPU seul)
subtitle: annonces vérifiées sur photo (autres CPU AMD et composants écartés)
legend: threadripper = processeur AMD Threadripper / Threadripper PRO seul

primary.name: threadripper
primary.def: a standalone AMD Ryzen Threadripper or Threadripper PRO processor (processeur / CPU seul / Prozessor / processador / procesador), sold by itself — includes older Threadripper parts and newer Ryzen Threadripper/Threadripper PRO chips, not a motherboard, complete PC, or bundle

auxiliary.name: other amd cpu
auxiliary.def: a different AMD processor that is NOT a Threadripper/Threadripper PRO: Ryzen desktop CPUs without 'Threadripper' (Ryzen 3/5/7/9), EPYC server CPUs, A-series/APU chips

vars.other_note: anything else: Intel or non-AMD CPUs, motherboards, RAM, GPUs, complete PCs, cases, power supplies, cables, unrelated items
